conditions: The rule concerns a type-bound procedure and its receiver, with the procedure and record type declared in the same module.
limitations: This documents the bound procedure heading and receiver forms in the identified report. Compiler extensions and whole-program conformance require separate evidence.

triggers: Reassess an edition or source correction, changed evidence bytes, new contrary designer evidence, or change to the base Oberon identity.

statement: The Oberon-2 report places the receiver before the procedure name. A module-level procedure binds to a record type declared in the same module. The receiver is either a VAR parameter of that record type or a value parameter whose type is a pointer to that record.
